Definition: from G1909 and G3089; to solve further, i.e. (figuratively) to explain, decide:--determine, expound.
BiblicalUsage: Epilyo means to explain, to decide, to solve further. Jesus expounded all things to His disciples when they were alone; and the townclerk says if ye enquire anything concerning other matters, it shall be determined in a lawful assembly.
TheologicalSignificance: Jesus explains to His own in private, and the city decides its business in lawful assembly, and both are order, not confusion.
